title: Saved measurement
description: A length captured with the AR tape (or typed in), kept so it can be read back later and optionally tied to a job: a label, the length in metres, the unit it was taken in, a note and when/how it was captured. Known fields are typed; extra fields are allowed.

kind.description: A straight length, or an area/perimeter measured around a polygon.

lengthM.description: The measured length in metres (the canonical unit; display follows the user's unit preference).

areaM2.description: For an area measurement: the area in square metres.

perimeterM.description: For an area measurement: the closed-loop perimeter in metres.

unit.description: The unit system the measurement was taken in, for display.

method.description: How it was captured: AR tape or typed in.
